CL_FSPM2026.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
points: Issued on the day the Government released the Independent Committee report on the **Wang Fuk Court fire (Tai Po)**. Sets out **seven temporary, "extra-cautious" measures** for occupied buildings under large scale repair works, to take effect at once.
於政府公布大埔宏福苑火災獨立委員會報告當日發出，列出**七項即時實施的臨時「加倍審慎」措施**，適用於有人居住而正進行大型維修的樓宇。

(a) No **combustible temporary materials** on scaffolding (non-fire-retardant nets, plastic sheeting, foam boards), especially in **lightwells and re-entrants**. (b) No storage of flammable materials, timber planks or scaffolding materials on scaffolding, especially above ground-level exits.
(a) 棚架上禁用**可燃臨時物料**（非阻燃安全網、膠布、發泡膠板），尤其天井及凹位；(b) 禁止在棚架上存放易燃物料、木板及棚架材料，尤其地面出口上方。

(c) No combustible materials (e.g. foam boards) on windows and external walls. (d) **No access openings at any means of escape** (staircases, lift lobbies); if unavoidable, protect openings in escape staircases with a **temporary fire barrier** of equivalent rating.
(c) 窗戶及外牆禁用可燃物料；(d) **所有逃生途徑不得開設工作通道口**；如無法避免，樓梯的開口須以同等耐火的臨時防火屏障保護。

(e) Windows at means of escape to have **fire-rated glazing or fire-resistant glass** (buildings with Fire Safety (Improvement) Directions). (f) Openable windows in staircases and lift lobbies of older buildings kept **closed** during the works. (g) Multi-building estates: repair external walls **in phases** (new works starting after 29 Oct 2026).
(e) 逃生途徑的窗須裝**耐火玻璃**（適用於已獲發消防安全（改善）指示的樓宇）；(f) 舊樓樓梯及升降機大堂的可開啟窗於工程期間須**關上**；(g) 多幢屋苑須**分期**維修外牆（適用於本通告後展開的工程）。

B(C)R ss 3 and 16: suitable, tested materials and proper methods and precautions; breaches may lead to **prosecution and disciplinary action**. BD is reviewing long-term requirements and will consult the industry.
《建築物（建造）規例》第 3 及 16 條：物料須合適並經測試，須採取恰當方法及預防措施；違者或被**檢控及紀律處分**。屋宇署正檢討長遠規定並會諮詢業界。
CL_FSPM2026.status_note: In force – temporary measures pending BD long-term review 有效（臨時措施，屋宇署正檢討長遠安排）

CL_SETRSTRF2026.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
points: From **1 December 2026**, submit **electronic test reports in standardised formats with digital signatures** for five HOKLAS tests: (a) concrete/grout cube strength; (b) concrete core strength; (c) physical tests of steel rebar (mass, tensile, bend, surface geometry); (d) rebar chemical composition; (e) in-situ soil density (sand replacement) and relative compaction.
由 **2026 年 12 月 1 日**起，五類 HOKLAS 測試須提交**標準化格式並附數碼簽署的電子測試報告**：(a) 混凝土／灌漿立方體強度；(b) 混凝土芯強度；(c) 鋼筋物理測試；(d) 鋼筋化學成分；(e) 泥土現場密度及相對壓實度。
Builds on CEDD Public Works Laboratories practice (since Aug 2023) and the 17 Dec 2025 circular. Standard Forms jointly developed by PWL, Housing Authority and HKAS.
承接土木工程拓展署公共工程實驗所的做法（2023 年 8 月起）及 2025 年 12 月 17 日通告；標準表格由公共工程實驗所、房委會及香港認可處制定。

ESH accepts digitally signed reports since **29 Aug 2026**; e-statements of certification by RC authorized signatories and RSE by end Nov 2026. BD uses CEDD **SmarTest** to check reports for **Forms BA13/BA14**.
電子資料呈交平台自 2026 年 8 月 29 日起接受數碼簽署報告；屋宇署以 SmarTest 系統自動核對報告，加快處理 BA13／BA14。
Paper or unsigned e-reports after 1 Dec 2026 need **supplementary proof of authenticity** (e.g. a letter from the laboratory office bearer); BD intends to **phase out** them.
2026 年 12 月 1 日後提交紙本或無數碼簽署報告，須另交**真確性證明**；屋宇署擬逐步停止接受。

CL_FPSN2026.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
points: **GB 5725-2025 "Fall protection – Safety nets"** supersedes GB 5725-2009 from **1 September 2026** as the accepted fire retardant standard for protective nets under **PNRC 85**.
**GB 5725-2025《墜落防護 安全網》**由 **2026 年 9 月 1 日**起取代 GB 5725-2009，作為 PNRC 85 接受的防護網阻燃標準。

RCs must check the **date of manufacture** (before/after 1 Sep 2026) so the right standard is used in the sampling test (PNRC 85 para 6), and give the laboratory the date and the **manufacturing method** (拉絲經編 / 浸漬塗覆 / 絞合編織) for GB 5725-2025 nets.
註冊承建商須核實**生產日期**以採用正確測試標準，並向實驗所提供生產日期及（GB 5725-2025 網的）**生產方法**。
CL_FPSN2026.status_note: In force – standard now part of PNRC 85 有效，標準已列入 PNRC 85

CL_ATGMWCSE2026.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
points: Follows the **Building (Planning) (Amendment) Regulation 2026** (mandatory **elderly-friendly design**, B(P)R **reg 73**, in force **1 Aug 2026**). The Minor Works Technical Guidelines (2024 Ed.) gain a "comply with B(P)R 73" consideration in 11 sections.
配合 2026 年 8 月 1 日生效的《2026 年建築物（規劃）（修訂）規例》（**長者友善設計**，B(P)R 第 73 條），《小型工程監管制度之技術指引》11 節加入須符合第 73 條的考慮。

Sections amended: 3.5.1 roof finishes; 3.9.1 protective barriers; 3.10.1/3.10.2 forming and reinstating slab openings; 3.14.1/3.14.2 non-load-bearing RC and block walls; 3.16.1 metal gates; 3.24.1 sub-division of flats; 3.25.1 internal staircases; 3.27.1 partition walls in flats; 3.28.1 thickening of floor slabs.

Appendix (Chinese) also restates e.g. original finish thickness = design imposed load (kPa) × 1,000 / 23 (mm); roof barriers ≤ 2 m high; windows with sill ≤ 1.1 m form part of a barrier. English TG to follow.
附錄（中文）亦重申例如原設計飾面厚度 = 設計外加荷載（千帕）× 1,000 / 23（毫米）；天台護牆欄障不高於 2 米；窗台 ≤ 1.1 米的窗構成欄障一部分。英文版稍後發出。
CL_ATGMWCSE2026.status_note: Incorporated into the Minor Works Technical Guidelines (Aug 2026 amendments) 已納入小型工程技術指引

points: **Tied-back walls** (anchored into ground outside the excavation) give a strut-free excavation. If tie-backs **encroach into an adjoining lot**, get acceptance from the authorities or the owner's permission **before** works start.
**後拉式圍牆**（錨入挖掘範圍外的土地）可免除橫撐。如後拉件**伸入毗鄰地段**，須於動工前取得當局接受或業主許可。

**LandsD Information Note (7 Jul 2026)**: streamlined permission for **temporary ground reinforcements** (anchors, tie-backs, soil nails, dowels) in **adjoining Government land** for site formation and ELS – no need to prove exceptional geotechnical reasons. **Permanent** reinforcements are not covered.
**地政總署資料說明（2026 年 7 月 7 日）**：簡化審批**臨時**地基加固物伸入**毗鄰政府土地**作地盤平整及挖掘支撐，毋須證明特殊岩土理由；**永久**加固物不適用。

Criteria (a)–(h): no sterilising future use or stability; land not needed during the works; embedded portion only, no surface works or effect on vegetation; **de-stress** pre-stressed elements; **retract and reinstate**, or leave in only if **easily breakable** (e.g. GFRP bars, GEO decides); temporary use; complete by the proposed date; before **OP**, retract or remove anchor heads.
條件 (a)–(h)：不影響日後發展或穩定；施工期間土地不需作他用；只限埋入部分、不涉地面及植被；預應力須**卸載**；用後**拔除並復原**，或只可留下**易於鑽破**物料（如玻璃纖維筋，由土力工程處決定）；屬臨時性質；按期完成；申請**佔用許可證**前須拔除或移除錨頭。

Plans approved by BD (with GEO and PlanD comments); permission at **nil fee** (admin and excavation permit fees only); parent company signs a **Deed of Indemnity** and maintains affected slopes (GEO); AP/RSE/RGE certifies extent, period, retraction and safety. Not for land allocated to departments; roads go to **HyD**.
圖則須經屋宇署批准（附土力工程處及規劃署意見）；許可**免地價**（只收行政費及挖掘准許證費）；母公司須簽**彌償契據**並維修受影響斜坡；認可人士／結構／岩土工程師須證明範圍、工期、拔除及安全。已撥予部門的土地不適用；道路由**路政署**處理。
Projections on or over streets may need **BO s 42 modification** of **s 31(1)**.
涉及伸出街道上空或之下者，或須按《建築物條例》第 42 條申請修改第 31(1) 條。

CL_GRDNBMRPCMCDS2026.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
points: Annual reminder (June 2026). **Rodent-proofing design** encouraged in new buildings, especially food premises (Appendix).
每年提示（2026 年 6 月），鼓勵新建樓宇（尤其食肆）採用**防鼠設計**。

Sites: follow FEHD guidance on mosquito prevention (before and through the **rainy season**); **weekly** inspections for breeding places; rodent disinfestation **≥ 3 months before completion**; demolition sites: disinfest before evacuation starts and until demolition ends; audit anti-mosquito measures if summonsed.
地盤：按食環署指引防蚊（雨季前及期間）；**每星期**巡查積水；完工前**最少 3 個月**滅鼠；拆卸地盤由清拆開始至完成持續滅鼠；如被傳召須即時檢討。

Appendix design rules: no voids behind built-in furniture; skirting voids ≤ **6 mm**; **no false ceilings** in kitchens and food stores (else compartmentalise with metal plate, gaps < 6 mm); block openings > 6 mm with mortar or **22 SWG** mesh ≤ 6 mm; **300 mm** metal kick plates on wooden doors (gap ≤ 6 mm); pipes **≥ 100 mm** apart and from walls; rat guards **550 mm** dia projecting 230 mm; flower bed walls **> 1 m** with ledges; channel gratings ≤ 6 mm aperture.
附錄設計：固定傢俬背後不留空隙；踢腳線空隙 ≤ **6 毫米**；廚房及食物倉**不設假天花**（否則以金屬板分隔，空隙 < 6 毫米）；> 6 毫米的開口以砂漿或 22 SWG 網封堵；木門底裝 **300 毫米**金屬踢板；水管相距及離牆 **≥ 100 毫米**；防鼠罩直徑 **550 毫米**；花槽牆 **> 1 米**；渠蓋孔隙 ≤ 6 毫米。

CL_RMWMS2026.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
points: Launch of the **Registration and Minor Works Management System (RMWMS)**, https://rmwms.bd.gov.hk, on **29 May 2026**, for registration applications (AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC) and Minor Works / Signboard Control System documents (forms list: APP-60, PNRC 2).
2026 年 5 月 29 日推出**註冊及小型工程管理系統**，處理各類註冊申請及小型工程／招牌監管文件（表格見 APP-60 及 PNRC 2）。

Functions: online forms; **iAM Smart** authentication and digital signing; inbox for signed certificates and acknowledgements; status tracking; map of works location; online payment. Encouraged as an alternative to paper.
功能：網上填表；**智方便**認證及數碼簽署；收件匣接收證書及確認信；查閱進度；地圖標示工程位置；網上付款。

CL_PMCSRTS2026.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
points: **Scaffolds**: competent person inspects before and after tropical cyclones and heavy rain (more often when signals are up). Measures: (a) enough ties at the cantilevered top; (b) at most **one floor** above the topmost floor; (c) adequate putlogs, ties, bracing, brackets; (d) when a signal or strong monsoon signal is hoisted, remove or lower and tie up screens and lower the scaffold above the top floor to **≤ half a floor**; (e) no loose materials. Remove idle scaffolds; replacements of protective materials follow **PNRC 85**.
**棚架**：熱帶氣旋及大雨前後由合資格人士檢查。措施：(a) 頂層懸臂部分有足夠拉結；(b) 高出頂層**不多於一層**；(c) 足夠橫桿、拉結、斜撐、鋼托架；(d) 懸掛信號時拆除或降低保護網，頂層以上棚架降至**不高於半層**；(e) 不放鬆散物料。更換保護物料須符合 PNRC 85。
**Tower cranes**: slew jib downwind and free-slew; trolley at minimum radius, hook up; luffing jib at **15°** or per maker; tie per maker; lower the tower if needed. Secure **gondolas**.
**塔式起重機**：吊臂轉至下風並自由迴轉；小車移至最小半徑，吊鈎升至最高；俯仰臂置於 **15°** 或按廠方建議；需要時降低塔身。**吊船**須穩妥固定。
Update emergency contacts with BD using the **ADM-3** form; inspect and repair after signals are lowered; duties under B(A)R regs 37 and 41.
以 **ADM-3** 表格更新緊急聯絡；除下信號後盡快巡查及修葺；注意《建築物（管理）規例》第 37、41 條責任。

**Flood prevention** (DSD): avoid temporary works reducing drain capacity; protect stockpiles; maintain **silt traps**; design temporary site drains; keep road drainage working under TTAs; no **illicit connection** of surface water to foul sewers.
**防洪**（渠務署）：臨時工程不得減少排水量；遮蓋堆料；保養**隔沙池**；妥善設計臨時排水；臨時交通安排不得阻塞路面排水；不得把地面水**非法接駁**至污水渠。

After incidents of vehicles hitting scaffolds over streets: keep the **vertical clearance** over the carriageway per **TPDM Vol 2 Ch 3 Table 3.5.1.1**, or else the **horizontal clearance** from the kerb per **Table 3.5.2.1**.
鑑於車輛撞及街道上方棚架的事故：棚架須符合《運輸策劃及設計手冊》第 2 卷第 3 章表 3.5.1.1 的**垂直淨空**，否則須符合表 3.5.2.1 與路緣的**水平距離**。

If not achievable, prepare a **temporary traffic arrangement (TTA)** per the HyD Code of Practice for Lighting, Signing and Guarding of Road Works; submit to TD regional office and Police before erection (GS paras 1.14–1.16); tell **bus operators** on bus routes.
如未能符合，須按路政署《道路工程照明、標誌及防護工作守則》擬備**臨時交通安排**，於搭建前交運輸署及警方；在巴士路線上須通知**巴士公司**。

CL_FSPMMBRW2026.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
points: For large scale repair works (A&A, renovation, maintenance, repair, minor works): comply with **FS Code Clause F5.6** – (a) keep **means of escape** clear, signed and lit; (b) fire doors kept closed and in good order; (c) maintain fire barriers; (d) alternative measures if MOE blocked; replace fire doors/lights immediately or use a **temporary barrier** of equal rating.
大型維修工程須遵守**消防安全守則 F5.6 條**：(a) 保持**逃生途徑**暢通並有指示及照明；(b) 防火門保持關閉及良好；(c) 保持防火屏障；(d) 逃生途徑受阻須有替代措施；更換防火門時須即時換上或以同等耐火臨時屏障保護。

(e) **Fire retardant** nets/screens/tarpaulins/sheeting meeting **PNRC 85**, sampled and tested before installation (also MBIS/MWIS CoP, MW TG, APP-70). (f) Store combustibles safely; **no foam boards** on external walls and windows. (g) Do not cover windows (except localised, temporary). (h) **Dangerous goods** above exempt quantities only in FSD-licensed stores. (i) FSI shutdown per FSD. (j) Extinguishers and fire blankets accessible, workers trained. (k) Emergency plan communicated to owners and occupants.
(e) 使用符合 **PNRC 85** 的**阻燃**保護網／帆布／膠布，安裝前須抽樣測試；(f) 可燃物料妥善存放，外牆及窗**不得裝發泡膠板**；(g) 不可遮蓋窗戶；(h) 超過豁免量的**危險品**須存於持牌倉；(i) 消防裝置停用按消防處規定；(j) 滅火筒及滅火氈易於取用並培訓工人；(k) 制定並通知緊急應變計劃。

B(C)R ss 3 and 16 apply; do a **risk assessment** (including fire) before works; consider **phasing** external wall works in multi-building developments; effective fire safety management per FS Code Part F.
《建築物（建造）規例》第 3 及 16 條適用；動工前進行（包括消防）**風險評估**；多幢發展項目可考慮**分期**進行外牆工程；按消防安全守則 F 部實施消防安全管理。
CL_FSPMMBRW2026.status_note: In force; supplemented by the seven measures of 29 Oct 2026 有效，並由 10 月 29 日七項措施補充

CL_USFMWCS2026.to: AP, RSE, RGE, RI, RGBC, RSC, RMWC
points: After **PNRC 85** (Dec 2025): **Form MW01 Part E** and **Form MW03 Part B** now ask PRCs to confirm (i) whether Class I/II works involve scaffolding over **three or more consecutive storeys**, and (ii) that protective materials were **sampled and tested** per PNRC 85 before installation.
按 **PNRC 85**（2025 年 12 月）更新 **MW01 表格 E 部**及 **MW03 表格 B 部**，訂明承建商須確認 (i) 第 I/II 級工程是否涉及**連續三層或以上**棚架；(ii) 保護物料已按 PNRC 85 **抽樣測試**。

Submissions **on or after 23 Feb 2026** must use the new forms, or be returned. Class III works with such scaffolding: test and send e-reports to BD; notify BD within **7 days** after installing protective materials. Scaffolding covering a whole elevation of those storeys or the full height of a re-entrant/lightwell counts; truss-out scaffolds for single units excluded.
**2026 年 2 月 23 日或以後**須用新表格，否則退回。第 III 級工程如涉及此類棚架亦須測試並提交電子報告，於安裝後 **7 日內**通知屋宇署。覆蓋整個立面或整條天井的棚架計算在內；個別單位的懸挑棚架除外。

From **1 April 2026**, QPs who submitted all MBIS/MWIS specified forms on time over the last **180 consecutive days** get a ✓ "Timely Submission of Specified Forms in the Last 180 Days" on BD's QP register; one late submission removes it until another 180 clean days.
由 **2026 年 4 月 1 日**起，合資格人士在過去**連續 180 日**按時提交所有指定表格，可在屋宇署名冊獲顯示 ✓；一次遲交即被取消，須再連續 180 日按時才恢復。
Duties under B(I&R)R and **PNBI-3**; BO **s 30E** – non-compliance may lead to prosecution or disciplinary action. Use the e-Forms system.
職責見《建築物（檢驗及修葺）規例》及 **PNBI-3**；違反《建築物條例》第 30E 條可被檢控或紀律處分。鼓勵以電子表格提交。

Before typhoons: (a) check roof, podium, flat roof and basement drains; (b) check external projections and installations (scaffolds, signboards, **photovoltaic panels** and supports); (c) pumps at flood-risk areas (plant rooms, basement car parks); (d) inspect slopes and retaining walls; (e) protect exposed glazing and lock windows and curtain walls; (f) secure gondolas; (g) cordon off **tree-fall** zones.
颱風前：(a) 檢查天台、平台及地庫排水；(b) 檢查外牆伸出物及裝置（棚架、招牌、**光伏板**）；(c) 水浸風險區（機房、地庫停車場）備抽水設備；(d) 巡查斜坡及擋土牆；(e) 保護外露玻璃並鎖好窗及幕牆；(f) 固定吊船；(g) 封閉**塌樹**範圍。
After bad weather, appoint competent persons to inspect and repair promptly.
惡劣天氣後盡快委任合資格人士巡查及維修。

Bamboo scaffolds: (a) competent person inspects ties, bracing, brackets, ledgers and posts; (b) regular inspection and maintenance; (c) dismantle promptly after works by **trained workmen** under supervision; (d) report **abandoned** scaffolds to BD. More frequent inspections around tropical cyclones; PNRC 85 for replacing protective materials.
竹棚架：(a) 由合資格人士檢查；(b) 定期巡查及保養；(c) 工程完成後由**受訓工人**盡快拆除；(d) 發現**棄置**棚架須通知屋宇署。颱風期間增加巡查；更換保護物料按 PNRC 85。
References: Labour Department **CoP for Bamboo Scaffolding Safety**, BD leaflet on strong winds, **Guidelines on the Design and Construction of Bamboo Scaffolds**.
